title: When the Witness Breaks Anew
author: Kestrel Ishikawa
blurb: Emrys Joubert, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has spent five years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the trial begins.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
